programs.notes: No programme-specific cut-off aggregate is published. The university's own 2026/2027 Admissions Notice and its Undergraduate Entry Requirements page both state only a general bar: credit passes (A1-C6) in three core subjects (English Language, Core Mathematics, Integrated Science) and any three relevant electives, with "an aggregate score of 36 or better in the best six subjects". 36 is therefore the site-wide general ceiling, not a competitive departmental cut-off. The same pages add "Meet the Departmental requirements", but those departmental requirements are not published anywhere on the site. No elective subjects are named for this programme (the requirement is "any three elective subjects"), so none are enforced.

Specific entry requirements published: "credit passes (A1-C6) ... in three core subjects including English Language (Core), Mathematics (Core), and Integrated Science and three elective subjects including Biology, Chemistry and Physics or Elective Mathematics." Biology and Chemistry are therefore unconditionally required; the third elective is an either/or between Physics and Elective Mathematics and is encoded as elective_options with minimum_required 1. No cut-off aggregate is published for this programme, so the site-wide ceiling of 36 applies. No programme-specific cut-off aggregate is published. The university's own 2026/2027 Admissions Notice and its Undergraduate Entry Requirements page both state only a general bar: credit passes (A1-C6) in three core subjects (English Language, Core Mathematics, Integrated Science) and any three relevant electives, with "an aggregate score of 36 or better in the best six subjects". 36 is therefore the site-wide general ceiling, not a competitive departmental cut-off. The same pages add "Meet the Departmental requirements", but those departmental requirements are not published anywhere on the site.

Published per-programme cut-off: "The cut-off point for admission is an aggregate of 14 or better" (Undergraduate Entry Requirements page, School of Nursing and Midwifery section). Entry text: credit passes in the three cores plus "three elective subjects including Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Elective Mathematics" - four subjects for three slots, so it is encoded as an any-three-of-four elective_options block. The page adds that applicants with General Arts, Home Economics with Biology or General Agriculture electives MAY be considered; that discretion is not modelled here. Admission also requires passing a selection interview.

Published per-programme cut-off: "The cut-off point for admission is aggregate 14 or better" (Undergraduate Entry Requirements page). Entry text asks for credit passes in the three cores plus "three elective subjects including General Science, General Arts, and Home Economics with Biology" - those are SHS programme streams rather than WASSCE subject names, so no individual elective is enforced. The page notes students with science electives are preferred, and admission requires a selection interview.

CKT-UTAS diploma entry (Diploma Entry Requirements page, repeated verbatim in the 2026/2027 Admissions Notice): "three credit passes in the applicant's area of specialisation (elective subjects) and at least two passes (D7, D or better) in English Language (Core) and Mathematics (Core)". No elective subjects are named, so none are enforced. No aggregate ceiling is published for diplomas and D7 cores are accepted, so no aggregate bar is applied (54 = Open); subject requirements still apply. Note: the published text names only English and Core Mathematics; Integrated Science is listed here at the same D7 pass level because the engine always screens the three universal cores.
